stories.title: Treasury yields ease from multi-decade highs before FOMC minutes
stories.summary: Treasury yields fell back after they hit multi-decade highs. Traders position ahead of the release of the Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting minutes. The pullback gives relief after a long rise in yields.
stories.whyItMatters: Treasury yields set the benchmark for borrowing costs across the economy, from mortgages to corporate debt.
whatToWatch: The release of the FOMC minutes
Whether yields resume their climb after the minutes
questions: What will the minutes reveal about the Fed's rate path?

stories.title: 30-year Treasury yield hits 19-year high of 5.33% on inflation, spending concerns
stories.summary: The 30-year Treasury yield rose above 5.33%. That is a fresh 19-year high. Investors cited inflation and government spending concerns as the cause.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher long-term yields raise borrowing costs for mortgages, business loans, and the federal government.
whatToWatch: Upcoming inflation data and the FOMC minutes
questions: Which spending concerns drove the move?

stories.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said the market has turned too negative. He said that pessimism opens buying opportunities for investors. The comments add to a wider debate on market sentiment.
stories.whyItMatters: Cramer's commentary moves retail sentiment and can shift short-term flows into or out of stocks.
whatToWatch: Which sectors or stocks Cramer names as opportunities
questions: Does broader market data support Cramer's contrarian view?

stories.title: Steyr Motors' H1 2026 profit slumps even as order backlog grows
stories.summary: Steyr Motors reported a slump in profit for the first half of 2026. The company's order backlog grew in the same period, per its earnings call. The gap points to a mismatch between orders and near-term profit.
stories.whyItMatters: The results show margin pressure even as demand signals, seen in the backlog, stay firm.
whatToWatch: Whether the backlog turns into revenue and profit in coming quarters
questions: What drives the profit slump despite rising orders?

stories.summary: Shares of Investment AB Latour fell 27% after the company released its second-quarter 2026 results. The company detailed the results on its earnings call. The size of the drop points to a sharp reset in investor expectations.
stories.whyItMatters: A 27% one-day drop is a large repricing for a listed investment firm and may signal wider concern about its holdings.

stories.summary: Rockwool raised its revenue outlook. The company held its margin target unchanged. Shares fell, which suggests investors wanted more on profit, not just sales growth.
stories.whyItMatters: The reaction shows markets price margin trends as closely as revenue growth right now.
whatToWatch: Whether Rockwool revises its margin target in future updates
questions: Why did Rockwool hold its margin target steady despite higher revenue guidance?

stories.title: Ask MarketWatch: I hold power of attorney, executor, and trustee roles. How much power is that?
stories.summary: A reader asks MarketWatch about serving as power of attorney, executor, and trustee for a mother-in-law, all at the same time. The column looks at what those combined roles mean in practice. This is a personal-finance advice piece, not a market-moving story.
stories.whyItMatters: Estate and fiduciary roles affect how family wealth transfers, a recurring concern for readers who plan ahead.
questions: What limits apply when one person holds all three roles?
